raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 스타일이 확연히 다르게 느껴지면 좋겠어. 레이아웃은 각 스타일과 읽기 흐름에 맞게 선택하고, 잘 작동하는 구도는 여러 시안에서 공유해도 돼. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial assessment of only the exact permitted pins. Read packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and adapter; verified input hashes/byte counts and read all five pinned production manifests without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so actual source opens and protected-layout reads are zero. Then actually opened and visually inspected all 15 exact PNGs via tools.view_image with detail original, emitted as images through functions.exec: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, image judgment, any image score or diversity score. After that sequence, made actual first raw readings from the displayed native pixels in member/copy order and retained them in session memory. Date/hour spacing ambiguities in M1–M4 prompted one actual additional native re-open for each of those four members, resolving those entries while retaining every first raw reading. No other poster revisit, source substitution, generation/edit, peer record, producer self-inspection, spawned/resumed/forked critic, fabricated opening event or runtime session identity was used. PNG headers were separately checked against packet dimensions; all native PNGs have RGB color type 2. Ratings and diversity are this critic's own pixel judgments, not averages or maker intent.

content_form.location: center-right watering action and bottom workbench
content_form.observation: A hand tilts a red can and water visibly enters a living plant's pot; soil, a trowel and a cloth make the care activity specific. The surrounding plants and window light connect the action to growing plants at home.

hierarchy.observation: The title, cream promise and red watering can provide strong entry points, but the explanation's second line runs toward foliage and the small access/care/invitation/URL group recedes into dark, irregular plant imagery. The lower reading route works with effort rather than being fully resolved.

hierarchy.location: left information column and central red can
hierarchy.observation: The can and title dominate while the explanation and practical participation lines form a very fine strip; the visual action survives reduction more convincingly than the requested detailed invitation.

typography.observation: Both numeric ranges read with spaces flanking the en dash. This is a retained copy mismatch, distinct from the allowed optical spaces around the middle-dot.

The small white body letters cross from a plain blue area toward leaf shapes. The final invitation and URL are particularly fine over dark, uneven foliage; the expressive title is clearer than the practical small text.

space.location: left blue area and diagonal hand/can/pot path
space.observation: The large blue reserve accommodates the title and most copy while the diagonal can points toward the lower-right pot. Cloth, trowel and soil extend the action along the bottom edge, with clear room between the headline and the red vessel.

image_material.location: hand, can, water stream, leaves and tabletop
image_material.observation: Opaque brush marks remain coherent across the hand, red can, terracotta pot and sunlit work surface. The stream connects the spout to the soil rather than floating independently, and the tools have readable silhouettes.

emotion_control.location: red-orange can against blue and sunlit plants
emotion_control.observation: The warm red-orange action against the saturated blue ground conveys active, hands-on pleasure in care. The scene has energy without adding unrelated celebratory graphics.

ai_slop.location: watering stream and bottom tools
ai_slop.observation: The care objects have a clear reason to be present; the water ends at the pot and the trowel sits on the soil-strewn table. Dense brush texture is consistent with the picture language rather than a random texture patch.

procedure.method: This fresh independent session read only the supplied pinned inputs. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so no source image opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. All five pinned native-evidence manifests were read, without following their embedded producer paths. All 15 exact poster files were then actually opened and visually inspected via functions.exec/tools.view_image with detail:'original', emitted as images in sequence M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Only after the fifteenth view did the first copy-reading/transcription stage and all judgments/scores begin, using those displayed pixels. The first 60 readings were retained untouched in session memory; none was filled from packet copy. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed or performed. Hash, byte, dimension and RGB opacity checks were separate read-only checks, not claims of semantic viewing. Native dimensions are 1672×940 for M1 and 1672×941 for M2–M5: 16:9 passes only nearest-integer-single-edge height rounding at ±0.5 px, not exact native equality. Usage720 is 720×405 and thumbnail320 is 320×180 for every member. No images were generated/edited, no peer/producer records or unlisted paths were opened, no agents spawned/resumed/forked, and no session/tool-event identity is invented.

emotion_control.location: pale pink, plum shadows and gentle hand

evidence.observation: A bright photographic triptych pairs held small pot, leaf macro and larger tree with a pale cyan information column. It differs from M3's tighter monochrome root/hand process strip, although both use clean photographic panel grids and gothic display.

Volumetric broad brushwork, blue/orange light contrast, a diagonally pouring can and cream serif title create an active domestic painting; this differs from M4's flat ink shapes and M5's fine botanical diagram, beyond palette/font substitution.

evidence.location: left root/hand sequence and dark right column
evidence.observation: Tight tactile close-ups and a repotting sequence produce documentary attention to roots and touch, compared with M1's brighter size/product/detail collage. Monochrome alone is not the basis of the distinction; the viewpoint and content sequence also change.

Flat green leaf silhouettes, orange hand gestures, purple pots/bench and rough print marks produce a graphic market poster language. Its two-plant selection/handling scene differs from M2's painted watering and M5's single cutaway plant, despite a shared left information stack.

evidence.location: botanical foliage and root cutaway with right text
evidence.observation: Fine veins, a diagrammatic exposed root system, gentle supporting hand and pink/plum/green atmosphere form a botanical study. The subject construction and delicate material differ from M2's room/action painting and M4's assertive flat print, not just a softer filter.

residuals: The five achieved systems are clearly distinct at the professional level, but all keep a large upper headline, promise/paragraph and a serif date-led lower information stack. This shared successful reading order is permitted and limits exceptional diversity rather than requiring five unique layouts.

M1 and M3 retain the closest family relationship through photographic paneling, gothic headline and similar type-role scaling; their different subject sequence/crop/emotion provide distinction beyond monochrome alone.
M1–M4 have retained exact-copy range-spacing failures. The independent diversity value does not cancel those per-image mandatory failures or typography scores of 3.

content_form.location: left roots-to-potted-plant sequence
content_form.observation: Exposed roots held in hands, soil detail and the final potted specimen give repotting and care advice a concrete visual form. The root closeups are substantial and informative rather than token imagery.

hierarchy.location: right information column and left panels
hierarchy.observation: The large title/promise and the root images have balanced emphasis. Paragraph, date/hours/place and lower support form a consistent readable sequence.

hierarchy.location: split between left root sequence and right title
hierarchy.observation: The title and tactile root closeups remain identifiable even when supporting copy becomes small.

typography.observation: The native revisit resolves the date's ordinary sidebearings, but the hours retain visibly separate spaces around the range dash. This exact-copy defect remains.

typography.location: large gothic title versus fine lower support
typography.observation: Glyphs are clear and aligned, but title and schedule scale dominate relatively small invitation/URL and care lines; range handling remains unfinished.

space.location: half-width photo sequence and right inset column
space.observation: Consistent thin separators divide three image crops, while the right text is inset with a stable left edge. Copy groups have purposeful intervals and neither the lower URL nor the title is clipped.

image_material.location: hands, soil and branching roots in first two panels
image_material.observation: Skin folds, soil granularity and root continuity remain coherent in the close crops. The lower planter and care table use compatible photographic light and focus rather than a contradictory composite.

emotion_control.location: two upper root closeups and dark right field
emotion_control.observation: The tactile care action is clear, but two similar root-ball crops concentrate the emotional weight on a sober demonstration. The final living plant offers some relief; the progression does less to articulate the requested pleasure of choosing and living with plants.

emotion_control.location: whole frame relative to M1 and M5
emotion_control.observation: The repeated roots and heavy title establish a conventional instructional mood more than a distinct personal home-care invitation. This limitation concerns the scene's emotional development, not a rule against desaturated work.

ai_slop.location: root-ball hands and lower care-table photograph
ai_slop.observation: No visibly contradictory hand-to-root contact, floating pot or extra symbols are present. The close root material has coherent local detail; the repetition is a composition/emotion limitation rather than a fabricated anatomy claim.

residuals: First date read stays untouched; one native revisit resolves its range spacing. Hours remain an exact-copy failure.
Two root-ball panels repeat similar emphasis, reducing the emotional development toward choosing and home enjoyment.
M1 and M3 are related photographic systems; reversal, desaturation and care subject alone leave the full-five distinct-style condition unresolved at a functional, not strong, diversity level.
Native 1672×941 uses 0.5-pixel height rounding; no supplied source or protected layout applies.
